How to play & save your result
  1. Choose one answer, or match all three pairs. Each complete challenge is worth 1 point.
  2. Use Previous to change answers before finishing.
  3. After finishing, choose Download my result (PDF), then select Save as PDF in your browser’s print options.
  4. Upload your saved report to Classera/Classlight or send it to your teacher. Nothing is sent automatically.
